alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 23 at 10:34AM EDT until October 23 at 3:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...North winds around 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves around 3 feet. * WHERE...Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...Until 3 PM EDT this afternoon. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
